items.html: And these three discernments, called Neshama, are three names of HaVaYaH, and each of them is in the filling of Yodin, for also this rule will be in your hand: every aspect of Neshama is HaVaYaH of Yodin. However, the difference among these three names of Yodin is in the matter of their vowels. And the matter is, that also this rule will be in your hand: in AA all its names are in the secret of fillings, and also in the secret of vowels, for all of them are filled and vocalized. But the difference among them is in the matter of the order of the vocalization, how it is.
